about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Full-stack PM × designer's eye
about.status: Open to AI PM / Product roles · 2026 Cohort
about.bio1: I'm 25, based in Hohhot, open to relocation. UQ MSc Interaction Design under the School of Computer Science (Group of Eight, QS Top 50), BA Marketing at Binhai College of Nankai University — a deliberately T-shaped path through the technical, design, and business sides of shipping product.
about.bio2: What I actually do well: take a product from 0 to 1, solo — from user research and architecture all the way to full-stack implementation. I've shipped real 0→1 business products and built LLM / multi-agent projects. I define the spec, write the code, talk to the users. That's the loop I'm best at.
about.bio3: Most of my days now go into AI tooling — benchmarking different frontier models into real production decisions and wiring up multi-agent workflows to run my day-to-day. My belief: the best AI PMs are also AI builders.
